caption: The drawing depicts a cylindrical object with vertical bars resembling a grille, possibly the front grille of a car, with a domed lid on top that includes a central decorative knob. In the center of the grille is an ornate crest or badge containing a shield with the number "741" inscribed on it, and intricate scrollwork or drapery surrounding the shield. The object is rendered in grayscale, showing various shades of black and gray, giving the form a three-dimensional appearance with attention to highlights and shadows. The background is a plain off-white or beige color with minor stains and spots on some edges. The artist's signature, "Walton Kalamian," appears in the lower right corner.
title: Silver Tea Caddy
